name: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings
description: NCLH operates three cruise brands (Norwegian Cruise Line, Oceania Cruises and Regent Seven Seas Cruises) with 34 ships and about 71,400 berths at the end of 2025. About two thirds of revenue is ticket sales for the voyage; the other third is onboard spending (casino, drinks, spa, excursions, specialty dining) and other. Profit depends on filling ships (occupancy), the price per berth per day, fuel and payroll; the fleet is growing, with 17 more ships to be added from 2026 through 2037 under orders worth about $21.5B. It reports a single segment, so profit by brand is not disclosed.

gics.note: Conventional filing: GICS sector and sub-industry as listed on Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (read 2026-10-01); the list does not show the industry group or industry. SEC SIC code 4400 (Water Transportation) per EDGAR.

hq.note: 7665 Corporate Center Drive, Miami, FL 33126 (10-K cover); incorporated in Bermuda

employees.note: About 5,300 full-time shoreside plus about 39,200 shipboard employees (sum computed). FY2025 10-K

businessLines.name: Passenger ticket
businessLines.how: Guests pay a fare per berth per voyage, usually booked months ahead with deposits collected up front; fare level and occupancy drive it.
businessLines.description: Cruise fares including the stateroom, meals and entertainment included in the fare, across all three brands.

revenue.note: 68.0 percent of $9,827.6M total revenue per the 10-K (value computed from the 68.0 percent share; 67.7 percent in 2024). H1 2026 total revenue $4,971.8M vs $4,645.1M.

businessLines.name: Onboard and other
businessLines.how: Guests pay per purchase onboard once aboard; revenue per passenger day rises with pricing, bundled packages and pre-cruise sales. Costs include the products and excursion operators.
businessLines.description: Casino, beverage, specialty dining, spa, shore excursions, retail and other spending onboard, plus other revenue.

revenue.note: 32.0 percent of total revenue per the 10-K (value computed; 32.3 percent in 2024). H1 2026 onboard and other revenue $1,699.6M vs $1,517.4M.

brands.name: Norwegian Cruise Line
brands.share: Three Prima Class ships on order for delivery 2026-2028. Brand revenue not disclosed

brands.name: Oceania Cruises
brands.share: Upscale brand (Allura Class ships, Sonata Class ships on order). Brand revenue not disclosed

brands.name: Regent Seven Seas Cruises
brands.share: Luxury brand (Prestige Class; brand name licensed from Regent Hospitality Worldwide). Brand revenue not disclosed

brands.name: Whole fleet
brands.share: 34 ships, about 71,400 berths at 2025-12-31; 22 ships Bahamas-registered and 11 Marshall Islands-registered per the 10-K

whatsNext.text: 17 additional ships to join the fleet from 2026 through 2037; 13 ships with effective orders have combined contract prices of about EUR 18.3B ($21.5B) at 2025-12-31
